transcript: This is a crazy glitch where you can one-shot any of the Alpha Pals in PAL World 0.1.5.1. All you need is either an Ice-type PAL, or in this instance, I've managed to do it with one of the Ice Grenades. So now we are in with the Jetragon, and as you can see, I just throw a couple of the Ice Grenades down, and then you can have either another grenade or a Rocket Launcher as shown on screen, and you can just shoot him while he is frozen, and he will just go flying up in the air. As sometimes it will show, it doesn't take any full damage at all. Don't worry, just do it again, and you can shoot him up in the air, and it will work this time. And once he drops down, it does 44,000 damage. Well, in this case, it did. It is sick. Such a cool little glitch to do. Very, very simple, just to farm those schematics and loot. Try it for yourself.
metadata_caption: How to ONE SHOT All of The ALPHA BOSS PALS in Palworld 0.1.5.1! Try it now! #shorts #palworld
